prompt: Name one of the ten busiest US airports by total passengers.
label: Getting Harder
asOf: By total passengers in 2024, per Airports Council International.
note: Ranked by TOTAL passengers, not enplanements - enplanements roughly halve the figures and reorder the list.

answers.name: Atlanta
answers.fact: 108 million passengers, the busiest in the world almost every year since 1998.

answers.name: Los Angeles
answers.fact: Fifth busiest, and the westernmost of the ten.

answers.name: Chicago O'Hare
answers.fact: Fourth at 80 million, and still short of its 2019 peak.

answers.name: Dallas Fort Worth
answers.fact: Second at 88 million, and larger in area than Manhattan.

answers.name: Denver
answers.fact: Third at 82 million, and the largest airport by land area in the country.

answers.name: John F. Kennedy
answers.fact: Sixth at 63 million. Renamed for the president weeks after his death in 1963.

answers.name: Las Vegas
answers.fact: Eighth, and its 58 million was the highest in the airport's history.

answers.name: Orlando
answers.fact: Ninth at 57 million, and the busiest airport in Florida.

answers.name: Charlotte
answers.fact: Seventh at 59 million, up 10% in a year - the fastest grower in the ten.

answers.name: Miami
answers.fact: Tenth at 56 million, and the busiest international gateway in the southeast.

distractors.name: Newark
distractors.note: Outside the ten by total passengers.

distractors.name: Phoenix
distractors.note: Outside the ten, though among the busiest by aircraft movements.

distractors.name: LaGuardia
distractors.note: A separate New York airport, outside the ten.
